metadata.description: Captured GET /api/mdm/updates/deployments/{uuid} immediately after create. Confirms: of the 5 fields DeviceUpdateDeploymentV1Model adds beyond the 7-field create model, only uuid and ranking are present on a freshly-created deployment; allow_user_deferral, max_number_of_deferrals, and priority are all omitted from the wire (never set by V1 create, and this API's NullValueHandling.Ignore drops unset optional fields entirely rather than emitting null).
